speaker: Narration
text: The Princess Frog lets out a final wail as its form dissolves into the whirling blizzard.

speaker: Narration
text: In the center of the crater, Ives sways before crashing into the snow.

speaker: Jackie
text: IVES!

speaker: Narration
text: Jackie presses her fingers to Ives' neck, checking for a pulse.

speaker: Ives
text: ...Jackie?

speaker: Jackie
text: I'm here! Just hold on. We have to get you back to Kade.

speaker: Ives
text: No can do, kid. My legs... they don't move.

speaker: Narration
text: Jackie scrambles through her pockets. Takes out her Serum. It's pink.

speaker: Narration
text: Jackie sets the serum in the snow.

speaker: Narration
text: And wraps her arms tightly around Ives.

speaker: Jackie
text: I-I can still carry you back.

speaker: Narration
text: Jackie gets under Ives' shoulder and begins to lift.

speaker: Ives
text: Ah, kid... Just, give me a sec.

speaker: Jackie
text: Ives, you don't have the time to–

speaker: Jackie
text: Alright. Just... please tell me you'll be alright.

speaker: Ives
text: Sorry, kid.

speaker: Ives
text: I can't be making any more promises I can't keep.

speaker: Ives
text: I promised before we'd find out what happened to your Ma, together.

speaker: Ives
text: Look at me now, not much use to you like this.

speaker: Narration
text: A burning sensation rises in Jackie's chest, threatening to burst from her throat.

speaker: Jackie
text: Ives, I'm so sorry, it's all my—

speaker: Jackie
text: "Fight its shape, not its strength."

speaker: Jackie
text: You taught me that. It saved my life.

speaker: Narration
text: Jackie pulls up her pant leg to reveal the dressing.

speaker: Jackie
text: We've been together the whole time.

speaker: Narration
text: Jackie eases Ives down with her arm.

speaker: Jackie
text: Every lesson, every exam, every terrible day.

speaker: Jackie
text: You were there, and you didn't ask anything from me in return.

speaker: Ives
text: Kid...

speaker: Narration
text: Jackie tightens her grasp on Ives' shirt.

speaker: Jackie
text: I... found out what happened to Ma.

speaker: Ives
text: ...You did?

speaker: Jackie
text: Yeah, she’s still hiding. But I think I see her shadow now.

speaker: Ives
text: ...You've been playing hide and seek with her for quite some time now. Haven't you.

speaker: Narration
text: Jackie grasps harder. Tears begin to stream down her face. She nods.

speaker: Ives
text: ...Shit. C'mere, these arms still work.

speaker: Narration
text: Ives rests her arms on Jackie's shoulders, and brings her close.

speaker: Ives
text: You know. I expected you to haul me off earlier.

speaker: Jackie
text: Y-you did?

speaker: Ives
text: Yeah. Glad I was wrong.

speaker: Ives
text: Wouldn't be sitting here hearing about your Ma otherwise.

speaker: Narration
text: Jackie's breathing steadies. And she pushes herself up to face Ives.

speaker: Jackie
text: It's about time we get going. Don't you think?

speaker: Ives
text: Yeah, I suppose so.

speaker: Narration
text: Jackie puts her right shoulder under Ives' shoulder, propping her up.

speaker: Ives
text: ...You're the one helping me off the floor now.

speaker: Jackie
text: ...Why not, you my babysitter or something?

speaker: Narration
text: Jackie puts her fist out. Ives looks at it briefly.

speaker: Ives
text: ...Hah, no. Never was.

speaker: Narration
text: And Ives meets it.

speaker: Ives
text: Will you... take me with you one more time?

speaker: Jackie
text: Yeah. Wherever I am. Wherever I'll go.

speaker: Ives
text: Good... That's good...

speaker: Narration
text: Ives lets out a long breath, before she closes her eyes and leans on Jackie's back.

speaker: Narration
text: Feeling Ives' breath quiet on her back. Jackie rolls to the side and heaves upward.

speaker: Narration
text: Standing against the wind and snow, Jackie turns towards the arm across her shoulder.

speaker: Jackie
text: Any time.

speaker: Narration
text: And begins the long trek back towards the firelight.
